title: Quint's account of rhythms from tap dancing to drums to piano
summary: Quint Davis explains that his rhythms began on his feet as a tap dancer, moved to improvised drums, and he taught drummers to back his piano, hence Professor.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
